notes.note: Bad credentials: sign-on redirects back to /signon with query err= and the on-screen sentence "Invalid operator ID or [REDACTED:SECRET]." Submitting with both fields blank produces the identical message (no separate required-field validation).

On success the URL becomes /menu, heading "MAIN MENU", banner "Signed on as J. TELLER (TELLER)", and the status line shows OPR/BR/session id, e.g. "OPR TELLER1 | BR MAIN-001 | 09/04/2026 17:09:59 | SID A5DB7071". Branch options: MAIN-001 - Main Office, WEST-014 - Westside, EAST-022 - Eastgate.

finish.name: Operator Sign On
finish.description: Establishes an operator session on the Meridian Core member-servicing console: enters operator ID, [REDACTED:SECRET] and branch on the OPERATOR SIGN ON screen and lands on the MAIN MENU. Returns the signed-on operator display name/role, the operator code, the branch code and the session id. Use it as the session-establishment prerequisite for other servicing capabilities. If the credentials are rejected it reports invalid_credentials rather than failing.

inputs.name: operatorId
inputs.description: Operator ID to sign on with, e.g. teller1

inputs.name: branch
inputs.description: Branch to sign on at, as shown in the Branch dropdown

outputs.name: signedOnAs
outputs.description: Operator display name and role shown on the main menu

outputs.name: operatorCode
outputs.description: Operator code from the status line

outputs.name: branchCode
outputs.description: Branch code from the status line

outputs.name: sessionId
outputs.description: Session identifier (SID) from the status line

businessOutcomes.title: Operator ID or [REDACTED:SECRET] rejected
businessOutcomes.operatorGuidance: Verify the operator credentials; the same message is shown for a blank operator ID or [REDACTED:SECRET].

businessOutcomes.title: Operator profile locked or disabled
businessOutcomes.operatorGuidance: Wording inferred, not observed. Have a supervisor unlock or re-enable the operator profile in security administration.

businessOutcomes.title: Session expired before reaching the main menu
businessOutcomes.operatorGuidance: Wording inferred, not observed. Re-submit the sign-on form.
